jobs.occupation: Extrusion Operator – 2 Shifts & Permanent Night Shift
jobs.description:
For a company in regio Wielsbeke we are looking for motivated and technically skilled Extrusion Operators to join the production team. We have opportunities available in both a two-shift system (early and late shifts) and a permanent night shift.

As an Extrusion Operator, you will be responsible for operating and monitoring extrusion machinery to ensure efficient production and consistent product quality.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate and monitor extrusion machines and production lines.

• Set up machines and adjust process parameters according to production requirements.

• Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with quality standards.

• Perform routine quality checks and make adjustments when necessary.

• Identify and report machine malfunctions or production issues.

• Carry out basic cleaning and maintenance tasks.

• Follow all health, safety, and production procedures.

• Work closely with colleagues and supervisors to achieve production targets.

 

Your Profile:

• Experience in extrusion or a similar production environment is an advantage.

• Technical understanding and a hands-on approach.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Flexible and willing to work either a two-shift system or a permanent night shift.

• Reliable, motivated, and eager to learn.

• You speak English or Dutch fluently.

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• Assembling components (steel toe cap, lining and steel sole) onto the mould

• Cleaning the machine

• After completing internal training, you will also be able to operate two other machines

• Experience as a production worker is required

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

• You have your own means of transport

• You have a good command of Dutch or English

As a Press Line Machine Operator, you are responsible for operating the equipment on the press line, ensuring that the clay is shaped and compacted to the correct form and density before the bricks enter the kiln.  Your Key Responsibilities:

• Preparing the production line according to the planned production schedule.

• Setting up and changing over the equipment to meet the required specifications.

• Operating the production line and monitoring/adjusting parameters in accordance with established procedures.

• Managing the loading and unloading of the drying chambers.

• Replenishing the hood kiln.

• Monitoring and adjusting the quality of the bricks produced.

• Recording production data and technical observations.

• Carrying out minor maintenance tasks and ensuring a clean and tidy working environment. 

Who Are You?

 

• You have a technical qualification or a strong technical aptitude.

• You have a basic understanding of automated equipment and systems.

• You have several years of experience as a machine operator or in operating more complex equipment, preferably in a production environment.

• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.

• You are willing to work day shifts, starting at 7:30 a.m.

jobs.occupation: Senior Finance Officer - Asset Management - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established and fast-growing asset management company based in Brussels, managing tens of billions of euros in assets on behalf of retail, private banking, and institutional clients. The organization has experienced significant growth in recent years and continues to expand its investment platform and international footprint.With a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture, the company combines the stability of a major financial institution with the agility of a specialized investment business.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as a trusted finance partner and deputy to the CFO when required.
• Prepare and review financial reports, management accounts, and regulatory reporting.
• Coordinate monthly and annual closing activities.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning exercises.
• Conduct financial analysis, scenario modelling, and business performance reviews.
• Support internal and external audit processes.
• Participate in strategic projects such as fund launches and international expansion initiatives.
• Guide and support junior team members on technical finance matters.
• Drive process improvements and reporting automation initiatives.

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Engineering, or equivalent.
• Minimum 7 years of experience within financial services.
• Experience in asset management, fund administration, private banking, investment services, or a regulated financial environment.
• Strong knowledge of accounting principles and GAAP.
• Solid experience with budgeting, reporting, and financial analysis.
• Ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
• Hands-on mindset combined with strategic thinking.
• Previous exposure to coaching or supporting junior colleagues is an asset.
• Fluent in English plus either French or Dutch.
• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Our client is one of Belgium's leading asset management firms, responsible for approximately €40 billion in assets under management (AUM) across investment funds and discretionary portfolios. With ambitious growth plans targeting €65 billion AUM by 2030, the organization continues to invest in top talent to strengthen its investment capabilities.Operating in a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment, the business combines the scale of a major financial institution with the agility of a fast-growing asset manager. Investment decisions are made in-house, with close collaboration between portfolio management, investment strategy, and external asset managers.

Jobomschrijving

• Monitor financial markets, macroeconomic developments, and geopolitical events to develop investment insights and recommendations.
• Contribute to strategic asset allocation decisions across multi-asset portfolios.
• Analyze investment opportunities and formulate portfolio construction recommendations.
• Support investment committees through market research, presentations, and strategic reporting.
• Evaluate and challenge internal and external investment views using quantitative and qualitative analysis.
• Oversee and assess internally managed and third-party funds, monitoring performance and positioning.
• Partner closely with portfolio managers to influence investment decisions and fund selection.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of investment processes, research methodologies, and monitoring frameworks.
• Prepare investment reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and commercial teams.

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Engineering, or related field.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in asset management, portfolio management, investment strategy, fund research, or investments.
• Strong analytical capabilities combined with a strategic and forward-looking mindset.
• Solid understanding of financial markets, macroeconomics, and asset allocation.
• Experience analyzing investment funds and/or multi-asset portfolios.
• Ability to transform complex financial information into actionable investment recommendations.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills.
• CFA, CEFA, or equivalent certification is considered a strong advantage.
• Fluent English required. French and/or Dutch are advantageous.

Our client is an international company active in a Industrial / Manufacturing industry, with operations across Europe and Africa. The organization is currently looking for an HR Freelance Support during a key transition period.

Jobomschrijving

As an HR Freelance Support your responsibilities are:

• Manage end-to-end HR operations for multiple countries.
• Coordinate payroll processes using Workday, Officient and external providers.
• Handle employee administration, holiday requests and HR documentation.
• Support payroll activities in Belgium, Denmark and South Africa.
• Ensure compliance with CP207 and internal HR policies.
• Act as the primary HR contact for employees and managers.
• Support process improvements and maintain HR data accuracy across systems.

As a HR Freelance Support your responsibilities are:

• Proven experience in a broad HR Generalist, HR Manager or HRBP role
• Strong operational HR mindset with a hands-on approach.
• Experience managing international payroll activities.
• Familiarity with Securex and Officient is highly preferred.
• Working knowledge of Workday and HRIS environments.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.
• Able to work independently and start on short notice.
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.

Our client is looking for an ICT Operations & Support to support end users and IT operations across several international locations. This position combines hands-on technical support, workplace technologies management, and coordination with global IT teams to ensure a seamless user experience and reliable IT services. It's a temporary contract with the possibility of a permanent position.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide first and second-line support for workplace technologies, end-user devices, and business applications.
• Act as the primary IT contact for multiple international locations, ensuring effective user support and service continuity.
• Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity, and collaboration tool issues.
• Coordinate with central service desk and infrastructure teams to manage incidents and escalations.
• Support the diagnosis of networking and telephony-related issues.
• Contribute to international IT projects, technology deployments, and infrastructure initiatives.
• Maintain accurate IT documentation, asset inventories, and ensure compliance with security standards and procedures.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in ICT Operations, Digital Workplace, End-User Computing, or IT Support environments.
• Strong knowledge of: Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint), Microsoft Copilot
• Good understanding of networking fundamentals:
• Experience working within IT service management environments and centralized support structures.
• English: professional proficiency required ; any other language is a plus

The organisation operates in the retail industry in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a GL Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Maintain accurate financial records and ensure transactions are recorded correctly.
• P&L analysis
• Preparing for financial audits
• Preparation of the monthly balance sheet
• Reconciliations
• Actins as point of contact with the banks
• Prepare and review journal entries to support reliable financial data.
• Check supporting documents to ensure complete and consistent accounting records.
• ...

A successful GL Accountant should have:

• Bachelor's degree in accounting & finance (or related field)
• 1 to 3 years' experience in accounting/finance
• Strong motivation, passion and ambition
• Fluency in French and Dutch, with a professional level of English
• Advanced Excel skills
• Experience with ERP systems
• Comfort working with finance colleagues on accounting matters.

The organisation operates in the Professional Services industry in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Prepare & format legal documents, letters and presentations to ensure clear and accurate output.
• Manage calendars, arrange meetings and coordinate appointments to support efficient daily planning.
• Organise files and maintain document records so information is easy to find when needed.
• Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence in a timely and professional manner
• Assistance with hotel and travel arrangements, taxis orders, restaurants reservations, preparations of expense reports, occasional assistance with roaming updates, occasional assistance with visa applications
• Billing assistance (formatting, saving, printing and coordination with Billing team), keep track of recorded client invoices
• Support the preparation of reports and documents for ongoing legal and business activities.

A successful Legal Assistant should have:

• Ideally you already have an experience in a similar function within a law firm
• English / French or Dutch
• Strong administrative and secretarial support skills.
• Confidence in managing diaries, meetings and changing priorities.
• Good document organisation and record-management capability.
• Clear written communication skills for professional correspondence.

The company is located in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Finance Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
• Support month-end and year-end financial closing processes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in audits and implement recommendations as required.
• Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making.

A successful Finance Officer should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Residence in Brussels/Belgium.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
• Ability to communicate effectively in both English and French.

Our client is a leading player in the financial services sector, known for its strong customer orientation, professional development opportunities, and collaborative culture. The company invests heavily in its employees and offers a stable environment where talent can grow and develop.

Jobomschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
• Advise clients on products and services that match their needs.
• Support customers throughout their journey and provide excellent service.
• Identify commercial opportunities and contribute to business growth.
• Work closely with colleagues to ensure an outstanding customer experience.
• Participate in client meetings, follow-ups, and sales initiatives.

• Master's degree (field of study is not important).
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in sales and customer relationships.
• Proactive, dynamic, and eager to learn.
• Team player with a positive attitude.

Wat ga je doen?

                                Wat bieden wij jou?

Our client is a Luxembourg-based investment holding company (SOPARFI). They are looking for an Accountant to support the accounting and financial reporting of its holding and financing activities.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain the general ledger and record daily accounting transactions.
• Account for investments, intercompany loans, interest, dividends and related transactions.
• Perform bank and intercompany reconciliations.
• Prepare periodic closings and annual accounts under Luxembourg GAAP.
• Contribute to IFRS reporting, including adjustments and supporting schedules.
• Monitor cash movements, prepare payments and maintain cash flow forecasts.
• Support tax compliance and any applicable VAT obligations with external advisers.
• Liaise with auditors and maintain complete supporting documentation.

• A degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
• Up to five years of relevant experience, ideally with Luxembourg holding companies or a corporate services provider.
• Working knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and IFRS.
• Familiarity with the accounting treatment of investments and intercompany financing.
• Strong Excel skills and familiarity with accounting software.
• Accuracy, sound organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
• Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with external stakeholders.
• Fluency in French and English.

As Partnership Manager, you will play a central role in developing and maintaining ESN International's corporate partnerships, ensuring that they create meaningful benefits for international students, volunteers and the organisation. You will manage existing relationships, identify new business opportunities and help strengthen the financial sustainability of ESN International through mission-aligned partnerships.

Working closely with ESN's leadership and internal teams, you will combine relationship management, business development and the implementation of partnership activities.Account Management & Business Relations

• Serve as the main point of contact in all matters related to current partners' concerns and needs, building and strengthening client relationships to achieve long-term partnerships. 
• Maintain accurate client records, keeping track of contractual conditions, commitments and Key Performance Indicators. 
• Work with other internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure ESN's commitments towards partners are being fulfilled. 
• Manage and develop affiliate marketing and direct marketing strategies for ESN and its partners.
 

ESNcard Support & Roll-out of membership benefits

• Support the development of ESNcard.org and ErasmusCareers.org to improve international students' membership experience with the Erasmus Student Network.
• Coordinate the customer support of queries from students related to student offers and membership questions. 
• Maintain ESN's content management system related to student offers and its linked communication channels, to monitor promotion and visibility of corporate partnerships.
• Analyse data on usage and student engagement to assess impact and improve the offer and engagement.
 

Fundraising

• Identify key areas to further develop ESN's business relations connected to international student mobility, and prepare the acquisition of new partnerships in the corporate world
• Identify trends in corporate needs or opportunities in industries like tech, travel, or education; areas aligned with ESN's mission.
• Implement the partnership strategy to foster sustainable fundraising in cooperation with the Treasurer of ESN.
• Develop ESN's capacity to connect with business partners and foundations to offer them a solution for Corporate Social Responsibility. 
• Fundraise to roll out programs that address ESN International, in collaboration with internal teams in other departments to implement impactful initiatives with external stakeholders. 
• Identify potential diversification of ESN's corporate partnership portfolio and engagement of said partners. 
• Preferably a Bachelor's degree in a business-related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
• Experience working in an NGO, membership organisation or student-led organisation.
• Excellent negotiation skills to negotiate high-level commercial partnerships at the European level.
• Ability to manage and coordinate different stakeholder needs.
• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English, both oral and written: capable of leading negotiations and writing marketing copy.
• Great project management skills: budgeting, meeting deadlines and stakeholder management.
• An innovative and structured approach towards upcoming challenges.
• Proactive attitude. Not afraid of proposing changes and taking ownership of full projects and tasks.
• Ability to motivate and influence big networks of volunteers.
• Ability to manage and mentor the Digital Marketing Intern daily.
• Likes to work in teams and feels comfortable in a multicultural environment.
• Knowledge of the following will be highly appreciated:
• Affiliate and Referral marketing
• Social media marketing
• Email marketing
• Google Analytics
• Financial management
• Contract and/or Commercial law
• GDPR and other Data Privacy regulations 
• Full-time position (38 hours per week);
• One-year contract (prolongation depending on external funding);
• Gross monthly salary between €2500 and €2800, corresponding to ESN International's salary framework. Placement within the range will be determined by objective criteria, including relevant professional experience and competencies.
• A 13th month and holiday pay in accordance with the applicable Belgian employment conditions.
• Additional benefits, including meal vouchers, health insurance and public transport reimbursement.
• Access to further training (congé éducation) during working hours;
• Opportunities for professional development beyond training, such as networking or access to international conferences.
• Casual, friendly work environment;

For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

Are you an experienced CNC operator looking for a new challenge? We urgently need skilled professionals to join our team at our brand-new machine shop! Our workshop has moved to a location 10 times larger with many more machines, and we’re looking for enthusiastic people to help us grow!

• Experience in CNC programming, turning, and milling (if you only have turning experience, we have options, but milling experience alone is not sufficient).
• Experience with 5-axis machines and knowledge of more than 3-axis operations.
• Familiarity with Fanuc, Siemens, and Mazatrol Smooth.
• English is sufficient for communication in our workshop.
• Willingness to work in Day shift. We are open to considering day shifts.
• 95% of programming happens at the machine using dialog control (ShopMill and ShopTurn, Siemens 840D Solution Line).
• You must have a good understanding of G- and M-codes.

We are looking for a production worker with a good knowledge of English. Are you handy and able to work with a pneumatic nail gun?

This company, located in Lokeren, is a growing family business specializing in the production, repair, and recycling of wooden pallets. To strengthen their team, we are looking for a motivated pallet repairer. Do you enjoy hands-on, repetitive work, and do you not shy away from physical labor? Then you might be the colleague the company is looking for. 
Your tasks:
• Assembling and repairing wooden pallets according to our quality standards.
• Working with a pneumatic nail gun.
• Sorting pallets by type and quality.
• Keeping your workspace clean, organized, and safe.
• Collaborating with your colleagues to meet daily production targets.
 

What we ask of you:
• You enjoy working with tools and like manual labor.
• You are physically fit and willing to work at a steady pace.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality.
• You can express yourself in English; having another native language is no problem (but English is a must).

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? As a TIG or semi-automatic welder, you'll work on a variety of HVAC projects within the construction sector. You'll read plans, build custom installations, and weld pipes into perfect assemblies for heating and plumbing. Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. Thanks to the variety of high-end projects, your job remains technically challenging and educational. You'll be part of a large team where collaboration, quality, and safety are paramount.

What are your tasks?

• Reading and interpreting technical plans
• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)
• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment
• Communicate in English or Romanian
• Possession of a driver's license

jobs.occupation: Technical Assistant / Junior Technician - 2 Shifts - Bruges
jobs.description:
Have you completed a technical education, but do you not yet have the years of experience many vacancies ask for?

Then we would still like to hear from you!

For an automated production environment in Bruges, we are looking for a Technical Assistant / Junior Technician who wants to further develop within industrial maintenance.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What we do expect is a solid techncial foundation, an interest in machinery and, above all, the motivation to learn.

What will you do?

• Perform preventive maintenance
• Carry out basic technical interventions
• Analyse breakdowns and help solve them
• Check electrical and mechanical components
• Work with motors, sensors and production installations
• Replace or repair technical parts
• Perform small technical repairs and maintenance tasks
• Provide technical support for new machines and workstations
• Identify abnormalities and report them correctly
• Contribute ideas for improvements to machines and installations
During your first months, you will receive intensive guidance from an experienced technician.

• You have completed a full technical education
• For example in electricity, electromechanics, industrial technology or a similiar field
• Good basic knowledge of electricity and/or mechanics
• Willing to work in a 2-shift System
• You speak very good English and are willing to learn Dutch.
